_readme: Compact rosters for factions not yet drafted as full datasheets. Unit = [name, archetype id (catalogue/unit_archetypes.json), models (null = archetype range), overrides {stat: value, keywords, weapons}, key ability]. Faction 'dna' shifts every unit: MOV/CTRL are added; MS/RS/ARM are added (negative = better); MIGHT_inf adds to models with MIGHT ≤ 2; MIGHT_big multiplies larger models. Detachments: n = name, p = playstyle, r = rule, e = enhancements [name, bearer, text], s = stratagems [name, CP, 'When: effect'].

03.name: The Sun-Pyre Witch-Courts
units: Martyr's Zeal: when destroyed, bank 1 Pyre Die.
Purging Flame: [SCORCH] hits generate Pyre Dice.
Divine Guidance: a Pyre Die used here counts as a 6.
⟳ Act of Faith: spend 1 Pyre Die for the attached unit as if it were 2 dice.
Driven by Pain: +1 Attack while damaged.
Sanctified Ground: friendlies within 6″ bank dice on 5+ when they die.
Choir of Wrath: generates 1 Pyre Die per round while alive.

detachments.r: Pyre dice may also replace Charge and Damage rolls of [SCORCH] weapons.
e: Bank 1 extra die when the bearer's unit kills a unit.
Bearer's unit gets +1 to Wound with flamers.
s: Leader would be destroyed: roll D6, 4+ she survives with 1 MIGHT.
Unit is destroyed: bank 2 dice instead of 1.

detachments.r: Penitents may Charge after a Move.
s: Penitent unit destroyed: nearest enemy suffers D3 Fatal Wounds.
Penance Engine ends a Move: engaged enemies gain 1 Suppression token.

detachments.p: heavy sisters and Altar hold the line.
detachments.r: Units on objectives can spend a Pyre Die on a Save roll for free each round.
e: Bearer's unit gets +1 CTRL per model.
s: End of round: one objective becomes [SECURED].

04.name: The Aegis Knight-Houses
units: ⟳ Code of Honour: attached Cavaliers re-roll charge rolls.
Ion Shield front arc [WARD 4+]; rear attacks +1 to Wound.
Bulwark: friendly Squires within 6″ count double CTRL.

detachments.p: Big Knights joust in the centre.
detachments.r: Paladin-class Knights get +1 to Hit in melee when they charge.
s: Knight targeted: change its front arc before the attack.
Knight Moves: may move over Class 1–2 models; each suffers 1 Fatal Wound on 5+.

detachments.r: Two Squire-Walkers within 6″ of each other may activate as one activation.
e: +1 to Hit against a target another Squire-Walker hit this round.
Re-roll Hit 1s while within 6″ of a Paladin-Class Knight.
s: Squire-Walker targets a unit already damaged this round: +1 PEN.
Squire-Walker engaged: Move out without penalty.

detachments.p: Squires and Cavaliers support a single Knight.
detachments.r: Squire units within 6″ of a Knight have [SECURED].
s: A Knight is destroyed: every friendly unit gets +1 to Hit next activation.

05.name: The Abyssal Bathys-Corps
units: Pressure Seal: ignore Fatal Wounds on 6+.
[HARPOON]: drag the target 3″ toward the shooter.
Lure: enemies within 6″ get −1 to Hit against other targets.
⟳ Vent Brine-Fog: 6″ [STEALTH] field until next activation.
Big-Daddy Rage: +1 Attack vs a unit that harpooned or hurt a friendly this round.
Ink Cloud: once per battle, [STEALTH] to all friendlies within 9″.
Ballast: ignores difficult terrain; passengers disembark 6″.
Crushing Depths: units it pulls into engagement get −1 ARM.

detachments.r: Brine-Fog fields last until the end of the round and give Cover too.
e: Bearer vents fog without spending its ⟳.
s: Enemy engaged with a Drill Brute: −1 ARM.

detachments.r: Beasts within 9″ of the Leviathan get +1 Attack.
e: Enemies within 9″ that shoot must target Beasts if visible.
s: Beast fights a Rattled target: +1 Damage.
Beast unit not visible: redeploy it within 6″ of a fog field.

detachments.r: Units that did not Move get +1 to Hit with harpoons.
e: Harpoon drags may be toward any friendly unit.
Enemy vehicles pulled in suffer 1 Fatal Wound.
s: Harpooned unit can't Move next activation.

06.name: The Sanguine Aristocracy
units: Blood Cattle: a Lord within 3″ may heal 1 MIGHT by killing a Levy.
Deathly Charge: +1 Damage on the charge.
Crimson Hunger: heal 2 MIGHT per kill; free Epic Challenge.
⟳ Blood Kiss: attached unit heals 1 model's MIGHT on a kill.
Screech: an enemy unit within 6″ gets −1 to Hit.
Feeding Lunge: heals D3 MIGHT when it destroys a model (Sanguine lifesteal).
Hearse of the Damned: [UNYIELDING 5+] to friendlies within 6″.

detachments.r: Leaders heal 1 extra MIGHT per kill.
s: Leader targeted in melee: −1 to Hit.
Leader destroys a Leader: heal to full.

detachments.r: Cavalry heal 1 MIGHT each time they charge.

detachments.p: Masses of levies feeding the lords.
detachments.r: Levies within 6″ of a Lord have [SECURED].
e: Once per round heal 2 MIGHT on a Lord within 6″.
s: A Lord kills a Levy: heal 3 MIGHT.
A Levy unit is destroyed: return 5 Levies at your edge.
Enemies within 6″ of a Lord: −1 CTRL per model.

07.name: The Mordant Ghoul-Courts
units: The Court Grows: +1 model per enemy model they kill (max 150%).
Delusion of Chivalry: +1 to Wound vs units larger than themselves.
Royal Decree: choose the army's Delusion each battle.
⟳ Summon the Court: add 2 models to the attached unit.
Gravestone Clubs: Crushing Impact on charge.

detachments.p: Fast flayers and knights hunt isolated units.
detachments.r: Units charging a unit with fewer models get +1 Attack.
s: Mark an enemy Leader: +1 to Wound against it.

detachments.r: The Court Grows also triggers on kills within 6″ by any friendly unit.
s: After a kill: add 1 extra model and clear Broken.

detachments.p: The Zombie Dragon and the King lead.
detachments.r: Monsters gain +1 Attack (max +3) for each round in which 5+ models died within 6″ of them.
s: Dragon charges: target gains 2 Suppression tokens.

08.name: The Prometheus Flesh-Guilds
units: Machine-Fodder: harvest 1 Graft Token when destroyed near a Chirurgeon.
Field Surgery: spend 1 Graft Token to return a slain Servitor.
Data-Tether: re-roll Hit 1s within 6″ of a Leader.
⟳ Overclock: attached unit +1 to Hit; harvest range 9″.
Weld: Overload Fatal Wounds may be ignored by spending a Graft Token.
Graft Socket: Graft upgrades cost 1 less for this unit.
Galvanic Drive: +2″ Move after a Graft.
Vat-Tanks: harvest 1 Graft Token each round while alive.

detachments.p: Graft economy: build a monster mid-game.
detachments.r: Gain 1 Graft Token at the start of each round.
e: Bearer spends Graft Tokens on units within 6″.
First graft each round costs 1 less.
s: Unit damaged: apply a 1-token graft immediately.
Enemy model dies within 9″: +1 Graft Token.
Unit activates: +1 to Wound in melee.

detachments.p: techno-priest gunline: radium, arc and plasma.
detachments.r: Infantry that did not Move get +1 PEN.
Golems and Striders start with 1 free 1-token graft.
s: Golem destroyed: on 4+ it returns with 3 MIGHT (once).
Golem fights: engaged enemies suffer D3 Fatal Wounds.

09.name: The Frost-Skaer Blood-Raiders
units: Pack Hunt: +1 to Hit vs a unit already engaged.
⟳ Rune-Chant: +1 to Wound, heal 1 model, or +1 Save in melee.
Saga Keeper: units within 6″ fulfil Oaths on 2 conditions instead of 1.

detachments.r: Units that fulfil 'Slay a Leader' gain +2″ Move permanently in addition.
s: Unit charges a damaged unit: re-roll charge.
Unit kills a model: +1 Attack next fight.
Cavalry Move: may end within 6″ of enemy rear.

detachments.r: 'Hold the Line' oaths complete after 1 round instead of 2.
s: Unit on an objective targeted: incoming PEN −1.
Unit would become Broken: it doesn't.
Unit destroyed on an objective: it fights once more first.

detachments.r: Shamans cast 2 Rune-Chants per activation.
s: Enemy units within 9″ of a Shaman get −2″ Move.

10.name: The Dread-Fleet Buccaneers
units: Plunder: steal 1 CP when taking an enemy objective.
Boarding Action: +1 to Wound vs vehicles.
heavy rail-suit: Move and Shoot in either order.
⟳ Loot Call: steal 1 CP if the attached unit kills a unit.
Grenadoes: Shrapnel Grenades costs 0 CP once per round.
Full Sail: Move and Shoot in either order.
heavy rail-suit Volley: if both cannons hit the same target, [ONSLAUGHT 1].

detachments.r: Units disembarking get +1 to Hit that activation.
s: Enemy vehicle ends a Move within 6″: a unit moves into engagement with it.

detachments.r: Vehicles that did not Move get +1 PEN.
e: +1 CP at the start of the battle.
s: Vehicle shoots a vehicle: target −2″ Move.
Vehicle charged: its Firing Deck units fire at the charger.

detachments.r: Plunder steals on objectives held by the enemy last round, even if contested now.
e: Pick 1 objective: you score it double this game.
s: Enemy charge declared: charger must pass 4+ or switch target.
End of round: one objective becomes [SECURED].

12.name: The Black-Bile Congregation
units: Shamblers: give 1 Rot to engaged enemies at the end of the round.
Rot: damaging attacks give 1 Rot token.
Aura of Rust: engaged enemies −1 ARM.
⟳ Bell of Decay: enemies within 6″ gain 1 Rot.
Contagion Shells: each unit hit gains 1 Rot.
Miasma: enemies within 9″ gain 1 Rot each round.

detachments.r: Units with 3 Rot also get −1 to Hit.
s: Unit fights: [SHREDDING WOUNDS] vs units with 2+ Rot.

detachments.r: Engines get +1 Attack against units with 3 Rot.
Pox-Carriers grow +1 model whenever an enemy model with Rot dies within 6″.
e: Pox-Carriers within 6″ give Rot on hit.
s: Enemy model dies to Pox-Carriers: +1 model.

13.name: The Moloch Iron-Forged
units: Fuel: Engines may consume 2 models for Overdrive.
Siegecraft: ignore Cover vs units in terrain.
Siege Doctrine: +1 to Wound vs units in terrain.
⟳ Feed the Forge: consume 1 Thrall within 3″ to repair D3 MIGHT on an Engine (Consumption).
Hunger of Iron: Overdrive from up to 4 models.

detachments.r: Weapons get +1 PEN vs units in terrain.
s: Unit attacks a unit in terrain: +1 Damage.

detachments.r: Overdrive grants 2 effects per model consumed.
e: Consume 1 model per round without an Engine activation.

detachments.r: Infantry within 3″ of an Engine get +1 ARM vs ranged.
s: Unit Moves and Shoots without −1 Heavy penalty.
Unit charges a unit in terrain: Strike First.

14.name: The Cabal of the Inverted Star
units: Expendable Geometry: may be swapped with any friendly unit.
Teleport-Shunt: may arrive via Fate teleport.
⟳ Twist Geometry: swap the attached unit with another within 12″.
Shifting Form: random +1 Attack/MOV/ARM each round.
Vortex: once per round teleport a friendly unit within 9″.

detachments.r: +1 Fate per round.
e: Swaps cost 0 Fate once per round.
s: Enemy unit's WARD is worse by 1 this round.

detachments.r: Automata re-roll Hit 1s within 6″ of a Sorcerer.
s: Automata Move and Shoot without penalty.

detachments.p: Spawn and Pyre-Wisps pour through rifts.
detachments.r: Fate teleports may also bring units in from reserves.
s: Unit arrives: enemies within 6″ gain 1 Suppression.

15.name: The Velvet-Scourge Syndicate
units: Ecstasy of Pain: +1 to Hit once damaged.
Deafening: hit units −1 to Hit next activation.
⟳ Crescendo: attached unit counts as damaged (frenzy active).
Elegant Stride: Move and Shoot in either order.
Symphony: friendly units within 9″ count as damaged.

detachments.r: Damaged units also get +1″ Move.
s: Unit takes damage: it immediately counts as damaged and makes a 3″ Move.

detachments.r: [SUPPRESSIVE] hits give 2 tokens to Class 1–2.
s: Target becomes Pinned on any unsaved wound.
Unit shoots a Pinned unit: re-roll Wound.
All sonic weapons +1 PEN this round.

detachments.r: Leaders get [PRECISION] in melee.
e: Bearer −1 to be hit in melee.
s: Duelist attacked in melee: strike first.

17.name: The Sun-Scaled Temple-Host
units: Predatory Instinct: crits on 5+ vs damaged/Broken units.
Sworn Guardians: +1 Save within 3″ of a priest.
⟳ Celestial Geometry: one unit +1 to Wound this round.
Bloodroar: units charged gain 2 Suppression tokens.

detachments.r: Predatory Instinct also triggers vs units with any Suppression token.
e: A Saurian unit within 6″ crits on 5+ always.

detachments.r: Priests may teleport 1 unit 9″ per round (once).
e: +1 CP at the start of the battle.
s: D6 Fatal Wounds on a unit within 24″ (once).
End of round: score +1 VP if you hold the prophesied objective.

detachments.r: Units on objectives get +1 Save in melee.

18.name: The Obsidian Forge-Tombs
units: ⟳ Rune-Wall: attached unit −1 incoming Damage this round.
Rekindle: reanimation on 3+ for the attached unit.
Obsidian Core: [UNYIELDING 5+]; reanimates like a dwarf (whole model).
Grudge-shot: re-roll Wound vs the unit that killed a dwarf.

detachments.r: Reanimation max 3 per unit per round.
s: Unit would become Broken: it doesn't.
End of round: one destroyed unit returns with 1 model on 5+.

detachments.r: Settling the Grudge costs 0 CP once per round.
e: Mark 1 enemy unit at deployment: +1 to Hit vs it.
s: Unit attacks a grudge target: re-roll Wound.
Enemy kills a dwarf: +1 to Wound vs it for the battle.

detachments.r: Golems and Batteries get +1 PEN.
e: Golems within 6″ heal 2 at round end.
Attached unit's weapons [SCORCH]-touched: +1 Damage at half range.

19.name: The Skitter-Kin & Rad-Scavengers
units: Endless Swarm: return once at half strength.
Rad-Hardened: ignore 1 Fatal Wound per round.
⟳ Warp-Surge: the attached unit may Overcharge without suffering Fatal Wounds this round.
Packmaster's Whip: +1 Attack within 6″ of a Leader.
Tunnel: units embarked arrive with it.

detachments.r: Overcharge Fatal Wounds only on natural 1s that also fail to wound.
e: Once per battle: D6 Fatal Wounds within 24″.

detachments.r: Recycled units return at full strength.
e: Recycled units may arrive within 6″ of the bearer.
s: Unit not engaged: redeploy into reserves.
Friendly swarm in front: shooter must target it.

detachments.r: Hazmat units ignore Suppression.
s: Enemy within 6″ of a hose unit: −1 Hit.

20.name: The Astral Shadow-Clans
units: Raid Strike: may Strike from the Dark.
Blade Dance: +1 Attack on out-of-sequence activations.
⟳ Perfect Timing: the attached unit may Strike from the Dark this round.
Raider: units may disembark after it Moves and still charge.
Pain-Fed: +1 Attack per Pain token held (max +3).
Portal Shift: may activate out of sequence once per battle.

detachments.r: Units that disembark this round get +1 to Hit.
e: Bearer [WARD 3+] until it fails a save.
Gain 1 Pain when the attached unit kills a model.
s: Pass this turn even with more units (once per round).

detachments.r: Out-of-sequence activations get +1 to Wound in melee.
s: Engaged enemy tries to Move away: free strike.
Unit +2″ Move and +1 Attack this activation.
Unit kills a Leader: gain 2 Pain.

detachments.r: Agony-Engines start with 1 Pain each.
e: Pain tokens may be spent twice per round.

22.name: The Radiant Concordat
units: Volley Discipline: +1 to Hit vs marked units.
Blood-Mark: 1 Action to mark a visible enemy.
Offering Surge: spend Offerings for +1 Damage.
⟳ Consecrate: mark a target without spending an Action.
Bodyguard: intercept melee attacks on adjacent suits on 3+.
Stabilised: [HEAVY] bonus even after a 3″ Move.
Ritual Strike: +1 to Hit vs marked units.
Anchored: +1 to Hit if it didn't Move.

detachments.r: Marked units also lose Cover.
e: +1 CP at the start of the battle.
s: Enemy moves into view: Snap Fire 5+ (4+ marked).

detachments.r: Gore-Brutes get +1 Attack within 6″ of a battlesuit.
s: Suit targeted: Brutes within 3″ take the hits.
Spend 1 Offering: heal 2 on a Brute.

detachments.r: Stealth-Suits may mark targets themselves.
s: End of round: an objective with a suit becomes [SECURED].
All marked units −1 to Hit this round.

24.name: The Diesel-Skull War-Horde
units: Strength in Numbers: +1 Attack with 10+ models.
Full Throttle: [HAILFIRE] at full range after max Move.
⟳ RAMPAGE! once per battle; attached unit +1 Attack.
Ram: free Crushing Impact after 8″+ Move.

detachments.r: Vehicles and bikes get +2″ Move.
e: Once per battle: Move twice and charge.
s: Vehicle charges after Moving 8″+: Crushing Impact on 4+.
Vehicle ignores the next hit that would destroy it on 4+.

detachments.r: Strength in Numbers needs only 5 models.
s: greenskin mobs unit destroyed: 10 greenskin mobs arrive at the edge (once).

detachments.r: Walkers get [UNYIELDING 6+].
s: Walker ignores Rattled and gets +2″ Move.

25.name: The Eclipse Shadow-Fiends
units: Phase: move through terrain and models.
Terror: enemies within 6″ −1 to Hit in melee.
Drag into the Void: a model it kills can't be revived/returned.
Light-Drinker: enemies within 12″ −1 to Hit at range.

detachments.r: Units arriving through terrain get +1 to Hit that activation.
e: Bearer −1 to be hit in melee.
s: Attacker beyond 6″: −2 to Hit, no crits.
Enemy unit within 3″: it activates last this round.

detachments.r: [SHREDDING WOUNDS] on 5+ vs Broken units.
e: Attached unit +1 Attack per Broken enemy within 6″.
s: Kill a model: +1 Attack next fight.

detachments.p: The great void-beast and its shades.
detachments.r: Shades within 9″ of the Leviathan get +1 CTRL.
s: Leviathan destroyed: all units within 6″ suffer D3 Fatal Wounds.
